verdict.rationale: Docs clearly support running custom Docker images/templates: templates 'set up your rented machine with whatever software and formatting you need,' and users can 'Build a template - Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click,' launching 'prebuilt or custom templates with one click.' This is corroborated by CLI/API/SDK tooling to automate template creation and instance launch. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of custom Docker image workflows and more detail on Dockerfile/registry support specifics.
